name: Mother Tree Sanctuary — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Huge pink-blossom living tree with root-formed Gothic gateway/cloister, trunk windows and small branch/roof niches, dangling wish charms and integrated flower planting. Living wood supplies architecture; source is not a masonry castle covered by a tree. Hidden layout inference: A shaded root courtyard receives the forest path, a broad root arch leads to a quiet wish clearing, and one gentle loop follows exterior root alcoves. Higher trunk balconies can remain visual or connect through a declared route, not assumed navigable from artwork. Preserve hero canopy and rooted lower openings. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B18-STRUCT-001 — Mother Tree Sanctuary — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Existing GEN-08/23 tree/charm vocabulary needs identity matching before reuse. Need root gateway floor/seats, trunk-window reveal and branch-balcony contact/guard geometry where unseen. Low shade planting, blossom petals and occasional deer/butterflies; no replacement by ordinary 18m forest oak. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
